title: Face Sculpt #289 · 일본 20대 · 섹시한 · 인어 세이렌 · 유형 고유 메이크업 · P200 · 폭포형 샹들리에 · 안개 낀 숲
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful, seductive adult woman, mid 20s, a mermaid siren brought to life: dewy skin with real visible pores as if just risen from the sea, with iridescent pearlescent teal-and-opal scale-shaped highlights shimmering on her cheekbones, temples and along her jaw, long wet-look wavy hair in lilac-aqua falling past her shoulders. Her eyes are large, almond, slightly upturned, in sea-green contact lenses, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights, with pearlescent aqua eyeshadow, a soft glittering wing and long, dark lashes. Her lips are full, glossy, wet-looking coral-pink, parted just slightly. High, glowing cheekbones, a small straight nose and a delicate chin. A dreamy, magnetic, alluring gaze straight into the camera. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about one hundred and thirty-three in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: three separate septum rings of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; four small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; ten small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a gigantic multi-tier waterfall chandelier earring, a large classic round O-ring hoop in the lobe with three stacked tiers of marquise and teardrop gem drops cascading from it, each tier wider than the last, as wide as her palm and as long as her hand, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit twenty-nine pieces above the lobe: fourteen classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, nine studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and six in the conch and tragus; twenty small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; sixteen small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a misty forest at dusk, soft blurred dark-green trees fading into pale fog, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
